summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of NovaVision Teal Serenidad theme redesign. All 11 features verified successfully: Login with glassmorphism and teal gradient, logo without frame, dark sidebar (#0C2E2A), 4 main metrics with teal/blue colors, progress bars by type, alert cards for 30/60 days, Gastos badges (type and status), export buttons, navigation, and Usuarios with role badges.

Login button 'Iniciar sesión' has teal gradient (--teal-600 to --teal-500)
Logo appears without frame/border - transparent PNG floating on background
Login with superadmin/nova2024 credentials works correctly
Dashboard loads with dark sidebar (#0C2E2A / sidebar-teal class)
Sidebar logo displays without frame
4 main metric cards with gradient-teal icon containers
Metric colors: blue (Total Gastos), amber (Pagos Pendientes), teal (Gastos Pagados), red (Alertas)
Progress bars by type: blue (Gastos Fijos), teal (Proveedores), amber (Variables)
Alert cards for 30 days and 60 days with correct border colors
Gastos page displays type badges: fijo=blue, proveedor=teal, variable=amber
Gastos page displays status badges: pendiente, parcial, pagado, vencido
Excel export button functional
PDF export button functional
Nuevo Gasto button with btn-primary (teal gradient) opens modal
Nuevo Gasto modal has all form fields
Navigation: Dashboard route works
Navigation: Gastos route works
Navigation: Historial de pagos route works
Navigation: Pagos por vencer route works
Navigation: Gestión de usuarios route works
Usuarios page displays users with role badges
Role badges: superadmin (teal), admin (blue), usuario (gray)
Nuevo Usuario button with btn-primary opens modal
Nuevo Usuario modal has all form fields
Logout button present and accessible
